prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1071; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with a collision that occurred in a parking lot and resulted in personal injuries to our client. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative has been in contact with our client, please ensure that such contact ceases immediately.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this matter and the name of the adjuster handling it.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, vehicle data, dash camera footage, surveillance video from the parking facility, recorded statements, claim file notes, and any repair or appraisal records. Please suspend any routine deletion or overwriting of such materials. We look forward to your prompt written response.
